_note: MCP server configuration - synced with .opencode/opencode.json. Consumed by TWO consumers: (1) opencode (CLI) reads servers directly; (2) core/mcp/router.py _load_mcp_config_enabled reads `enabled` flag and normalizes names (lowercase + hyphens-to-underscores) so it matches TOOL_PREFIXES in core/mcp/servers/*. Servers not in TOOL_PREFIXES (e.g. symphony, git) are loaded but unused by the python router.
_bootstrap: tools/mcpServers/bootstrap/mcp_bootstrap.sh wraps npx-based servers to filter startup messages
